Reference help and explicit source comparison support the information-search interest; organizing appointments alone does not.
Helping someone access reference resources plus explicit organization and accuracy supports resource guidance.
A concrete filmed sequence/editing context is required. A disjunctive story/photo/film option cannot supply it.
The frozen footage/edit fact includes revising timing; precision remains separately required.
The specific program-writing/debugging context can support a previously unasked coding-subject question, not a general technology rating.
Explicit program-test context and deliberate testing support software-failure exploration.
Defect documentation requires careful records and communication in addition to testing.
An organized event is not necessarily a performing-arts activity. Initiative, coordination and organization remain required.
Venue/supplier coordination uses explicit organizational and logistics evidence; performing-arts interest is not a prerequisite.
Bills and supplier commitments need concrete financial-record and follow-through evidence; social-event enthusiasm is insufficient.

Motion/measurement comparisons can ground physical-science exploration without sky watching. Numerical modelling, repeatable testing and explicit research interest remain necessary; reporting also needs accuracy and explanation.

limitations: Research-only semantic and question-bank prototype, not independently validated question scales or observed student outcomes.

All source profiles, original response records and frozen interests are unchanged. New answers only reuse explicit typed facts/eligible exact option IDs; unavailable interests remain unfamiliar. No prose or job-title matching. One existing original motion/experiment context is explicitly encoded with exact source-field verification; the source profile and its unknown preferences are unchanged.

Sixteen mapping repairs reuse existing evidence; these are not newly observed answers. At most four newly offered activity/context questions per model are simulated. Selection uses prior evidence gaps and correlation, not degree, earnings, cohort, identity or desired coverage.

The existing legacy gate still requires both defining interests and two distinct activity domains. Expanded roles still require three defining domains. The two scoped specialist roles additionally need their actual vision or farm-production context. Existing response records remain unchanged when a claim moves to confirmation.

All supported education routes are retained alongside the first three highlights. Degree alternatives below that cap are not counted as new degree Top. College/graduate uses canonical route keys; associate-only routes are separate.

Pay, education routes, budget assumptions, correlation scores and ranking formula are unchanged. New activity evidence may change tie ordering and which three careers are highlighted. Missing pay remains unassessed.
Development and all three previously inspected holdouts use the same frozen rules with separate results. They are diagnostic, not pristine final validation.
